logging_refactor_verification.behavioural_impact: None. Every UX-visible flow (course load, course switch, reagent live render, reactive atom, plain snippet run, CTA hand-off, course-complete overlay, theme+progress persistence) behaves identically to iteration 5.

critical_code_review_comments: log.js: guard `typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.env && process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'` is correct for CRA (webpack inlines process.env.NODE_ENV at build time). Good defensive typeof check for any non-CRA runtime paths.

Consider adding a lightweight `error(...)` companion in log.js for cases where a real console.error is warranted (right now every catch uses debug, which silently drops in production — acceptable for the current diagnostics but worth revisiting if a truly unrecoverable path is ever added).

Minor: __reagent_roots roots in src/lib/sci.js are still never explicitly .unmount()'d on ReagentSnippet unmount (already flagged in iteration 5). Not caused by this refactor; carrying forward as a note.
